units.rawText: In my spare time, I help those who work in animal husbandry and agriculture.

spans.text: In my spare time, I help those who work in animal husbandry and agriculture.

units.rawText: Their lives depend on the well-being of livestock, and a seemingly insignificant issue could ruin an entire year's worth of hard work.
